name: ensureArray
requirements: Check if the input value is already an instance of an Array.
Return the original array if the input is already an array (avoiding nested wrapping).
Wrap non-array values (numbers, strings, objects) into a new array containing that single element.
Handle null and undefined by returning an empty array to ensure downstream iteration safety.
edge_cases: Input is null or undefined (returns empty array instead of wrapping null/undefined).
Input is a string (returns array with the whole string, does not split into characters).
Input is an object or function (returns array containing the object/function).
Input is already a populated or empty array (returns as-is).
example:
const items = ensureArray('single-item'); // ['single-item']
const list = ensureArray([1, 2, 3]); // [1, 2, 3]
const empty = ensureArray(null); // []
